name: Frost Moth
telegraph: Wing ocelli and mouth are ice blue; wings beat during the attack using the existing flap animation.
counterplay: Two separated straight shards; the wing tips are visual and not part of the body hitbox.
projectile: Forked ice chip. No freeze or slow debuff required.
notes: Suggested tuning only. Not an EnemyDef or spawn registration; gameplay unchanged. Projectile VOX is a visual concept; runtime uses procedural meshes.
